revisions.goal: Keep the local dashboard truthful and automatically synchronized with completed agent work, snapshots, plans, and repository state.
revisions.acceptanceCriteria:
- Completed snapshots are never presented as running agents.
- Only locked, unfulfilled plans appear as active agent work.
- Snapshot, plan, and repository queries refetch automatically without a manual page refresh.
- Dynamic API responses bypass browser caches.
- Adding a snapshot invalidates the global snapshot index immediately.
- Go tests, UI tests, production UI build, and a real-browser smoke check pass.

milestones.title: Correct active-work semantics
milestones.goal: Drive active agents and active plan counts from nonterminal plan state instead of completed snapshots.

milestones.title: Make local data live
milestones.goal: Poll dynamic query families, disable API caching, and invalidate the snapshot index on writes.

milestones.title: Verify end to end
milestones.goal: Run automated suites, production build, and browser validation.
